Variants.Content: Hornhill is the traditional castle of House Tarly in the southwest Reach, nestled in the foothills rising toward the Red Mountains. The territory of the Tarly family is not as famous for its prosperous palace as Highgarden, but it has land suitable for horse breeding, grazing and farming, and can provide well-trained knights and infantry to the lords of the Reach. The hilly position of Hornhill allows it to both observe the south-western road and link news from the Reach to the edge of Dorne. The military tradition here does not mean that the residents live only for war; the stability of the castle also relies on tenant farmers, granaries, stables, blacksmiths and seasonal labor.
